title: Clock gear found inside marble in Brazil
summary: Kiran Ilum Xenov tells of Clock gear found inside marble in Brazil, about Unspecified at Brazil, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: in Brazil, when they're sawing through marble mountains, cutting marble slabs, they find pieces of a clock inside the marble. They even found a gear.

plain: A guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, Kiran Ilum Xenov, introduced as a former president of a republic within Russia, says that in Brazil, workers cutting marble slabs out of mountains have found pieces of a clock inside the stone, even a gear. If true, it would mean made objects sealed in rock far older than any known human history.
